--- title: "Visualisierungen" subtitle: "Diagramme und Plots zu zentralen Workshop-Konzepten" --- ## 1. Kognitive Belastung: Verteilung im Arbeitsgedaechtnis Die Arbeitsgedaechtniskapazitaet ist begrenzt. Entscheidend ist, wie die drei Arten kognitiver Belastung diesen begrenzten Raum aufteilen. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cognitive_load_data <- tibble( scenario = factor( rep(c("Schlechtes Design", "Gutes Design", "KI-Outsourcing"), each = 4), levels = c("Schlechtes Design", "Gutes Design", "KI-Outsourcing") ), load_type = factor( rep(c("Extrinsische Belastung", "Intrinsische Belastung", "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung", "Ungenutzte Kapazität"), 3), levels = c("Ungenutzte Kapazität", "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung", "Intrinsische Belastung", "Extrinsische Belastung") ), percentage = c( 60, 30, 10, 0, 10, 30, 60, 0, 10, 30, 5, 55 ) ) |> filter(percentage > 0) |> group_by(scenario) |> mutate( y_pos = cumsum(percentage) - percentage / 2, label = if_else(percentage >= 8, paste0(percentage, "%"), "") ) |> ungroup() load_colors <- c( "Intrinsische Belastung" = "#64748b", "Extrinsische Belastung" = "#dc2626", "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung" = "#16a34a", "Ungenutzte Kapazität" = "#e5e7eb" ) ggplot(cognitive_load_data, aes(x = scenario, y = percentage, fill = load_type)) + geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) + geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8) + geom_text( aes(y = y_pos, label = label), color = "white", size = 4, fontface = "bold", family = "Lato" ) + annotate( "text", x = 3.45, y = 102, label = "Kapazitätsgrenze", size = 3.5, hjust = 0, family = "Lato" ) + scale_fill_manual(values = load_colors, name = "Belastungsart") + scale_y_continuous( limits = c(0, 108), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = paste0(seq(0, 100, 25), "%") ) + labs( title = "Verteilung der kognitiven Belastung", subtitle = "Arbeitsgedächtniskapazität ist begrenzt\u2002\u2013\u2002die Verteilung macht den Unterschied", x = NULL, y = "Arbeitsgedächtniskapazität" ) + theme_workshop() + theme( axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 9), plot.margin = margin(10, 50, 10, 10) ) + guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Verteilung der kognitiven Belastung in drei Szenarien. Die Gesamthoehe repraesentiert die fixe Arbeitsgedaechtniskapazitaet.](visualizations_files/figure-html/fig-cognitive-load-1.png){#fig-cognitive-load width=960} ::: ::: ## 2. Expertise Reversal Effekt Optimale Unterstuetzung haengt vom Vorwissen ab. Was Anfaengern hilft, schadet Experten, und umgekehrt. Permanentes KI-Scaffolding verhindert den Uebergang. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(42) expertise_data <- tibble( expertise = seq(0, 10, 0.5) ) |> mutate( worked_examples = 85 - 7 * expertise, problem_solving = 35 + 4.5 * expertise, permanent_scaffolding = 40 + 0.5 * expertise ) |> pivot_longer( cols = c(worked_examples, problem_solving, permanent_scaffolding), names_to = "condition", values_to = "outcome" ) |> mutate( condition = factor( condition, levels = c("worked_examples", "problem_solving", "permanent_scaffolding"), labels = c( "Worked Examples / Hohe Anleitung", "Problemlösen / Niedrige Anleitung", "Permanentes KI-Scaffolding" ) ) ) crossing_x <- (85 - 35) / (7 + 4.5) crossing_y <- 85 - 7 * crossing_x ggplot(expertise_data, aes(x = expertise, y = outcome, color = condition, linetype = condition)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point( data = tibble(x = crossing_x, y = crossing_y), aes(x = x, y = y), color = brand_dark, size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE ) + annotate( "text", x = crossing_x + 0.3, y = crossing_y + 7, label = "Fading Point", size = 3.8, hjust = 0, fontface = "italic", family = "Lato" ) + annotate( "curve", x = crossing_x + 0.3, y = crossing_y + 5, xend = crossing_x + 0.05, yend = crossing_y + 1.5, curvature = 0.2, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed"), color = "#666666" ) + scale_color_manual( values = c( "Worked Examples / Hohe Anleitung" = "#2563eb", "Problemlösen / Niedrige Anleitung" = "#16a34a", "Permanentes KI-Scaffolding" = "#dc2626" ), name = NULL ) + scale_linetype_manual( values = c( "Worked Examples / Hohe Anleitung" = "solid", "Problemlösen / Niedrige Anleitung" = "solid", "Permanentes KI-Scaffolding" = "dashed" ), name = NULL ) + scale_x_continuous( breaks = c(0, 5, 10), labels = c("Anfänger", "Mittel", "Experte") ) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(20, 90), breaks = seq(20, 80, 20)) + labs( title = "Expertise Reversal Effekt", subtitle = "Optimale Unterstützung hängt vom Vorwissen ab", x = "Expertise-Level", y = "Lernergebnis" ) + theme_workshop() + theme( legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm") ) + guides( color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Removed 2 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_line()`). ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Der Expertise Reversal Effekt zeigt, dass optimale Instruktion vom Vorwissensniveau abhaengt. Permanentes KI-Scaffolding (gestrichelt) verhindert die Expertise-Entwicklung.](visualizations_files/figure-html/fig-expertise-reversal-1.png){#fig-expertise-reversal width=960} ::: ::: ## 3. Testing Effekt Aktives Abrufen fuehrt zu besserem Langzeitlernen als wiederholtes Studieren, selbst wenn die Gesamtlernzeit gleich bleibt. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} testing_effect_data <- tibble( condition = factor( c("4\u00d7 Studieren", "3\u00d7 Studieren +\n1\u00d7 Test", "1\u00d7 Studieren +\n3\u00d7 Tests"), levels = c("4\u00d7 Studieren", "3\u00d7 Studieren +\n1\u00d7 Test", "1\u00d7 Studieren +\n3\u00d7 Tests") ), retention = c(40, 56, 61) ) ggplot(testing_effect_data, aes(x = condition, y = retention)) + geom_col( aes(fill = retention), width = 0.65, color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.3 ) + geom_text( aes(label = paste0(retention, "%")), vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = brand_dark, family = "Lato" ) + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f0a5bb", high = brand_accent, guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous( limits = c(0, 70), breaks = seq(0, 60, 20), labels = paste0(seq(0, 60, 20), "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)) ) + labs( title = "Testing Effekt", subtitle = "Aktives Abrufen führt zu besserem Langzeitlernen als wiederholtes Studieren", x = NULL, y = "Erinnerung nach 1 Woche (%)", caption = "Daten basierend auf Roediger & Karpicke (2006)" ) + theme_workshop() + theme( axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", lineheight = 1.1), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Daten basierend auf Roediger & Karpicke (2006). Wiederholtes Testen fuehrt zu deutlich besserer Langzeiterinnerung als wiederholtes Studieren.](visualizations_files/figure-html/fig-testing-effect-1.png){#fig-testing-effect width=864} ::: ::: ## 4. Das Lernparadox Subjektives Gefuehl und tatsaechliches Lernen koennen auseinanderklaffen. Die metakognitive Falle: Was sich leicht anfuehlt, fuehlt sich nach Lernen an, ist es aber oft nicht. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} quadrants <- tibble( xmin = c(0, 5, 0, 5), xmax = c(5, 10, 5, 10), ymin = c(5, 5, 0, 0), ymax = c(10, 10, 5, 5), quadrant = c( "Produktive\nAnstrengung", "Experten-\nEffizienz", "Unproduktive\nFrustration", "Illusion des\nLernens" ), fill_color = c("#16a34a", "#2563eb", "#9ca3af", "#dc2626"), importance = c("ZIEL", "OK für Fortgeschrittene", "Vermeiden", "FALLE") ) ggplot(quadrants) + geom_rect( aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = I(fill_color)), alpha = 0.3, color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8 ) + geom_text( aes( x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2 + 0.7, label = quadrant ), size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, color = brand_dark, family = "Lato" ) + geom_text( aes( x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2 - 0.9, label = importance ), size = 3.8, fontface = "italic", color = brand_dark, family = "Lato" ) + geom_curve( data = tibble(x = 8.2, y = 1.8, xend = 1.8, yend = 8.2), aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed"), curvature = -0.3, color = brand_accent, linewidth = 1.2 ) + annotate( "text", x = 5, y = 4.3, label = "Metakognitive Falle", size = 4.2, fontface = "bold.italic", color = brand_accent, family = "Lato" ) + scale_x_continuous( breaks = c(2.5, 7.5), labels = c("Schwierig", "Leicht"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + scale_y_continuous( breaks = c(2.5, 7.5), labels = c("Wenig", "Viel"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + labs( title = "Das Lernparadox", subtitle = "Subjektives Gefühl und tatsächliches Lernen können auseinanderklaffen", x = "\nSubjektives Gefühl beim Lernen", y = "Tatsächliches Lernen\n" ) + theme_workshop() + theme( panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8), axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = 12), plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15) ) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Das Lernparadox: Subjektives Gefühl und tatsächliches Lernen können in unterschiedliche Richtungen weisen. Die metakognitive Falle liegt im unteren rechten Quadranten.](visualizations_files/figure-html/fig-lernparadox-1.png){#fig-lernparadox width=960} ::: ::: ## 5. Offloading vs. Outsourcing: Ein Spektrum Nicht jede KI-Nutzung wirkt gleich auf das Lernen. Entscheidend ist, ob die lernrelevante kognitive Verarbeitung erhalten bleibt oder eliminiert wird. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} spectrum_examples <- tibble( position = c(0.12, 0.30, 0.50, 0.75, 0.92), label = c( "Taschenrechner\nfür Arithmetik", "KI prüft\nZitationsformat", "Studierender\nüberarbeitet\nKI-Entwurf", "Frage an KI ohne\neigenen Versuch", "KI schreibt\nden Aufsatz" ), y_offset = c(0.72, 0.72, 0.76, 0.72, 0.72) ) gradient_data <- tibble( x = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200) ) |> mutate(fill_value = x) ggplot() + geom_tile( data = gradient_data, aes(x = x, y = 0.2, fill = fill_value, width = 0.006, height = 0.15), show.legend = FALSE ) + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#16a34a", high = "#dc2626") + annotate( "rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0.125, ymax = 0.275, fill = NA, color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8 ) + geom_segment( data = spectrum_examples, aes(x = position, xend = position, y = 0.30, yend = 0.50), color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.6 ) + geom_point( data = spectrum_examples, aes(x = position, y = 0.50), size = 5, color = brand_dark, fill = "white", shape = 21, stroke = 1.5 ) + geom_text( data = spectrum_examples, aes(x = position, y = y_offset, label = label), size = 3.3, lineheight = 0.9, fontface = "bold", color = brand_dark, family = "Lato" ) + annotate( "text", x = 0, y = 0.04, label = "Cognitive Offloading", hjust = 0, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#16a34a", family = "Lato" ) + annotate( "text", x = 1, y = 0.04, label = "Cognitive Outsourcing", hjust = 1, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#dc2626", family = "Lato" ) + annotate( "segment", x = 0, xend = 1, y = -0.08, yend = -0.08, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both", type = "closed"), color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8 ) + annotate( "text", x = 0, y = -0.15, label = "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung: Erhalten", hjust = 0, size = 3.8, fontface = "italic", color = "#16a34a", family = "Lato" ) + annotate( "text", x = 1, y = -0.15, label = "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung: Eliminiert", hjust = 1, size = 3.8, fontface = "italic", color = "#dc2626", family = "Lato" ) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.22, 0.95), expand = c(0, 0)) + labs( title = "Spektrum: Cognitive Offloading vs. Cognitive Outsourcing", subtitle = "Nicht jede KI-Nutzung hat die gleiche Auswirkung auf das Lernen" ) + theme_void(base_family = "Lato") + theme( plot.title = element_text( face = "bold", size = 16, color = brand_dark, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5) ), plot.subtitle = element_text( size = 11, color = "#666666", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20) ), plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Das Spektrum von Cognitive Offloading (lernfoerderlich) bis Cognitive Outsourcing (lernhinderlich), mit konkreten Beispielen.](visualizations_files/figure-html/fig-offloading-spectrum-1.png){#fig-offloading-spectrum width=1152} ::: ::: ## 6. Arbeitsgedaechtnis-Flaschenhals Informationen muessen durch das begrenzte Arbeitsgedaechtnis, bevor sie im Langzeitgedaechtnis verankert werden koennen. ::: {.cell} ::: {#fig-bottleneck .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 7. Das Evaluationsparadox Das Evaluationsparadox als zirkulaere Abhaengigkeit: Um KI-Outputs zu bewerten, braucht man Fachkompetenz, die erst durch eigenes Lernen entsteht. ::: {.cell} ::: {#fig-evaluation-paradox .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: **Kontrast: Experten vs. Anfaenger** ::: {.cell} ::: {#fig-expert-novice .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 8. Versuch-dann-Prüfe Zyklus Das zentrale Designprinzip fuer KI im Lernkontext: Studierende generieren zuerst eigene Loesungen, dann vergleichen sie mit KI-Output. ::: {.cell} ::: {#fig-try-then-check .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
